championship.selection: top two by conference winning percentage

notes: The two teams with the best conference winning percentage meet in Atlanta. If exactly two teams tie for first, both play in the championship game and the procedure only decides the home team. The capped scoring margin caps points scored at 42 and points allowed at 48 in each conference game; this build compares the per-game average so the step stays fair if teams play a different number of conference games.
